facts.value: Sell A reconciliation of 2025 water sub-meter readings against resident bills; paid net-20 after delivery. to each buyer.
Community manager, Sunbelt Pines Manufactured Housing Community
Sunbelt Pines Manufactured Housing Community issued a request for quotes budgeted at $3,800 for a one-time water sub-meter billing reconciliation (RFQ, 2026-11-18).

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is correct and names the decisive gap. The only opening is one organisation (Sunbelt Pines MHC) with a single one-time RFQ budgeted at $3,800 (EVIDENCE, RFQ 2026-11-18). Even if won, it settles at most $3,800 net-20, which is 31.7% of the $12,000 target. One organisation is not a population. The card holds no buyerVolume fact and no conversionRates fact, so no further buyer and no close rate is established for the remaining $8,200. The card also names no reachable channel to other communities, only a reply to this RFQ email, so no live test is startable, and a CONDITIONAL stance would rest on a channel that does not exist on the record. The decisive link MARKET_VOLUME is the right one: CONVERSION only matters once there are other buyers to convert. The resolution has Brain bid the RFQ (fulfilment proved, $30 cost, $0 exposure, net-20 settles inside 40 days) and research other communities with dated requests in parallel, which is consistent with the evidence. Brain's planner agrees that CONVERSION and MARKET_VOLUME are unestablished.
findings: Arithmetic: maximum from the record is 1 x $3,800 = $3,800 against $12,000, a $8,200 shortfall with no counted source.
The gap is missing evidence (market volume), not a constraint. The plan correctly does not call it infeasible, and leaves replanning open once buyers are counted.
The RFQ bid is worth executing in parallel: delivery is a Brain-produced spreadsheet and the net-20 term settles inside the 40-day window if delivered by about day 18.
